explanation: I grepped Mathlib for `subset_mul_right`, `subset_mul_left` and related names. The only declarations with this statement are `Set.subset_mul_right` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Pointwise/Set/Basic.lean:616) and the target itself. The `Set` version is about `Set` rather than `Finset`. Getting from it to the `Finset` statement needs the coercion lemmas `coe_subset` and `coe_mul`, plus a proof that `1 ∈ ↑s`. That is more than routine glue, so I don't count it as a special case. A derivation from `Finset.mul_subset_mul_right`, `Finset.one_subset` and `one_mul` would combine several lemmas and isn't a single-declaration match either. I found no other `Finset` lemma with this statement.
